caption: An electric kettle is lifted off its base while it is boiling, and the kettle's light goes off and the boiling quiets.

sa.check: An electric kettle sits on its base, with steam or churning water showing it is boiling.
The kettle's light is lit at the start.
The kettle is lifted off its base.
The steaming or churning eases after the lift.
The order is boiling on the base, lift, light off.

pc.expect: The light goes out at the moment the kettle parts from the base, and only then.
pc.fail: The kettle is off its base and its light still shines; or the light goes out before the kettle moves; or the light goes out with the kettle still seated and only afterwards is the kettle lifted.

pc.expect: After the lift the boil dies down one way: the steam plume thins and any churning at the surface settles, and neither returns while the kettle is off its base.
pc.fail: The steam plume grows thicker after the lift; or the water churns harder once off the base; or the boil dies down and then returns with the kettle still in the air; or the light comes back on with the kettle off the base.

pc.expect: Steam leaves the spout and rises, drifting upward and spreading; it does not sink or pool.
pc.fail: Steam falls from the spout toward the counter; or hangs as a fixed shape that moves with the kettle like a solid; or steam rises from the empty base after the kettle is lifted.

pc.expect: The base stays on the counter as the kettle lifts off it; the counter and nearby items do not move.
pc.fail: The base lifts with the kettle and hangs beneath it; or the base slides across the counter by itself; or nearby items jump as the kettle is lifted.

pc.expect: One kettle and one base; the kettle keeps its shape with the lid on and does not pass through the base or the counter.
pc.fail: The kettle passes through its base or the counter; or a second kettle appears; or the base vanishes; or the kettle changes shape or its spout moves.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The kettle's colour, the base and the counter stay the same apart from the light and steam.
pc.fail: The kettle changes colour; or the base changes design; or items on the counter change.

note: 'The boiling quiets' is read visually: the steam plume thins and any visible churning settles. Sound is not judged, nor how far the boil has died down by the end of the clip.
